name: Tidy
author: CatVinci-Studio
description: Clean and orderly: a system sans on white, blue, yellow and red headings below level 2, green italic quotes, rounded task boxes and calm code. After Things by colineckert and Stephan Ango.

zh.description: 干净有序：白底上的系统无衬线字体，二级以下标题依次为蓝、黄、红，引用为绿色斜体，任务框为圆角，代码低调。参考 colineckert 和 Stephan Ango 的 Things。
